title: Topological closure of a subfield
statement: Let $H$ be a field [def-weil-field] with a topology making addition, negation and multiplication continuous and inversion continuous at every nonzero point. Let $F\subseteq H$ be a subfield, meaning a subset containing $0,1$ and closed under addition, negation, multiplication and inversion of nonzero elements. The topological closure $\overline F$ is a subfield of $H$, contains $F$, and is closed in $H$. Here topological closure means the set of points every open neighbourhood of which meets $F$.
